Lab: When Is Recovery Eligible?

Is this recovery plan eligible?

Toy policy: A/B allowed in EU only, RPO 60 seconds, RTO 600 seconds, 20-second lease. Loss bound = gap at isolation + lease. The plan is detection 60 + fencing 30 + restore + route 30 + validation 60 seconds. Safety gates decide promotion; a plan over the RTO is a separate planning miss to rehearse or redesign, not a block. Policy, approval, audit and bundle gates are assumed true here; Python tests exercise them. Results are computed from assumptions, not measured.
